answer: Locks are recorded in nebula, expire in haven, and crystal lists each expiry. An adversary running 33 aliases as a result needs 161 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. The admission bond is time locked for 28 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. A farm of 3573 identities would post 1598 proofs and burn roughly 35 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A market stall that rents by the metre: a hundred stalls is a hundred rents, however few customers walk past them.
